question: In a certain code language, ‘HEALTH’ is written as ‘CGJJVN’ and 'CHARGE' is written as 'CJEGIT'. How will ‘HOURSE’ be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa718dc3d80fa09b3eda3b7ebcb501ae0d35fbb68f85c6fcb0b5de22c71bf85f.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54c91e51a65c0fb777bc5b6b678e660d14109c3ebb608a74a884591c1617357.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa04ed8979dd3e1523031e4ea9963e0fdcbad76f26233a70d4a1023dc1dbea85.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9060b96e58fecffc487f67cf9b8a9cb205b01e2d5b43db28f1f5d3e9c250230.png] 

Hence, '**WQJGUT**' is the correct answer.
